name: Autodesk Navisworks Manage
knownFor: The default federated-model clash and 4D coordination tool in many US firms.
popCaption: Navisworks used by 71% of firms (Confluence 2025). Inventory: Manage 80 firms, Simulate 43 · G2: about 193–208 reviews, 4.6/5 · checked Nov 2026
pro: The common exchange format (NWC/NWD) almost every trade can deliver
con: The interface feels dated; issue tracking often lives in a second tool
costCaption: Official Autodesk list: Manage $2,835/year or $355/month; Simulate (review only) $1,145/year or $145/month (autodesk.com/products/navisworks/buy, checked Nov 2026). Rated on Manage.

name: Autodesk BIM Collaborate Pro
knownFor: Cloud worksharing and model coordination inside Autodesk Construction Cloud.
popCaption: Autodesk Construction Cloud 94% of firms; Autodesk Docs 76%; BIM 360 63% (72 firms) in Confluence 2025 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Live Revit worksharing plus a cloud coordination environment
con: Pricing and product names (ACC, BIM 360, Collaborate Pro) are easy to confuse
costCaption: Now sold as Forma Design Collaboration. Autodesk's buy page did not expose a numeric price in this session. Authorized reseller CAD Masters lists $925/year. Editorial estimate $$ · checked Nov 2026.

name: Revizto
knownFor: Issue tracking plus clash review in an interactive, game-engine-like viewer for office and field.
popCaption: 46 firms listed Revizto in Confluence 2025 · checked Nov 2026
pro: Easier for non-modelers to walk a federated model and leave issues
con: Another license on top of whatever you already use for clash
costCaption: Plans are per-user, per-project, or enterprise; the pricing page asks you to talk to sales for a quote (revizto.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Editorial estimate $$$$ (quote-only).

name: Trimble Connect
knownFor: Model federation and issue sharing across Trimble, Tekla, SketchUp, and IFC tools.
popCaption: 36 firms listed Trimble Connect in Confluence 2025 · checked Nov 2026
pro: A natural hub if the team already lives in Tekla, SketchUp, or SysQue
con: Less universal than ACC/Navisworks in US architecture-led surveys
costCaption: A free Personal tier exists. Paid Business plans are sold, but a clear US AEC list price was not confirmed on the Trimble Connect product page this session. Editorial estimate $ · checked Nov 2026.

name: Newforma Konekt (formerly BIM Track)
knownFor: BIM issue tracking connected to Revit, Navisworks, and other viewers, now under the Newforma name.
popCaption: BIM Track listed by 25 firms in Confluence 2025; Newforma (broader platform) listed by 48 — the 48 may include project-info tools beyond Konekt · checked Nov 2026
pro: Structured BCF-style issues that can live with the model
con: The rebrand makes historical survey labels a bit messy
costCaption: No public list price found; Newforma sells Konekt by quote (newforma.com/konekt/, checked Nov 2026). Editorial estimate $$$$ (quote-only).

name: Solibri
knownFor: Rule-based model checking and IFC quality control, especially in openBIM workflows.
popCaption: Only 7 firms listed Solibri Office in Confluence 2025 (architecture-weighted, Autodesk-heavy sample). It remains a standard in many openBIM/European specifications · checked Nov 2026
pro: Rules you can rerun, not just a one-off clash test
con: Low count in this US firm survey; expect more use on IFC-mandated work
costCaption: Official: Starter €99/year; Essential €1,428/year (solibri.com/our-offerings, checked Nov 2026). Rated on Essential, the coordination/checking seat.

name: Dalux
knownFor: Coordination, documents, and a well-regarded field app, especially in Europe and the Nordics.
pro: Strong field viewing and a single environment from office to site
con: No firm count in the Confluence 2025 inventory; US evidence is thinner than in Europe
costCaption: No public US list price found; Dalux sells platform plans by quote (dalux.com, checked Nov 2026). Editorial estimate $$ · not a published figure.

name: BIMcollab Zoom
knownFor: Open BCF issue management and clash/model review, with connections into authoring tools.
pro: BCF-native issue workflows that are not locked to one CDE
con: No independent 2025-2026 firm-survey count found this session
costCaption: BIMcollab order/plans pages list Zoom Single at €60/user/month with annual billing (about €720/year) (helpcenter.bimcollab.com and order pages, checked Nov 2026).

name: ClearEdge3D Verity
knownFor: Compares the coordinated model to laser scans to find what was actually installed.
pro: A clear answer to whether the install matches the model
con: Needs good scan data; no Confluence 2025 firm count found this session
costCaption: No public list price found; ClearEdge3D / Topcon sells Verity by quote (clearedge3d.com/products/verity/, checked Nov 2026). Editorial estimate $$$$ (quote-only).
